summary: Pull A day. Lunch and dinner lean on fresh chicken and shrimp preparations (Halloween-themed dishes today) to avoid repeating yesterday's shawarma chicken; today's wellness-bar option is the Chocolate Cookie Protein Smoothie, used pre-workout in place of an Evolve shake.

meals.name: Uber Breakfast
meals.note: Oats, eggs and turkey for protein and slow carbs, bread and banana to round out the carb target.

meals.name: Uber HQ Lunch
meals.note: New chicken noodle dish as the main for variety, extra chicken breast and black beans close out protein and fiber.

items.name: Haunted Mary's Free Range Chicken, Ants Climbing a Tree, Spicy Monster Mung Bean Noodle

meals.name: Uber Pre-workout
meals.note: Low-fat carbs and protein 60-90 min before lifting: today's wellness protein smoothie, lean turkey, and fruit for fiber without added fat.

meals.name: Uber Post-workout / Dinner
meals.note: Shrimp and black rice as the protein-forward main for variety, extra chicken breast, pasta and sweet potato close out protein and carbs.
